reviews.title: Wise restricted access to my money despite official EU-issued residence documentation
reviews.text:
I am a Ukrainian citizen legally residing in Bulgaria under temporary protection. I am deeply disappointed by how Wise has handled my case.
Wise requested updated personal information. I submitted my passport and an official Bulgarian Temporary Protection Registration Card, issued by the competent authorities of an EU Member State.
This government-issued document contains my photograph, personal identification number (LNCh), legal residence status, and officially registered current address.
The document is issued under Bulgarian law within the framework of Council Directive 2001/55/EC, Article 8. It is not an informal certificate but an official document confirming my legal status.
Nevertheless, Wise rejected my documents without adequately explaining why. After approximately ten days reviewing my formal complaint, Wise simply requested additional proof of address, such as utility bills or bank statements.

reviews.author: S. B.
reviews.replyText:
Hello Serhii, We can only imagine how difficult this situation must be for you, especially when you've already taken the time to provide official documents and explain your circumstances. Having trouble accessing your money and receiving payments for work is the last thing you need, and we understand how upsetting it must be to still be waiting for clear answers.
Sometimes, additional documents or checks may be needed to verify account information and keep Wise safe for everyone. We know this doesn't make the situation any less frustrating, especially when you've already made the effort to provide what's been requested.
We would really like to help you get some clarity on this to sort this out as soon as we can. Since we can't access or discuss account-specific details and verification statuses on public platforms, please drop us a private message on Facebook, X or Instagram with your registered email address so we can take a closer look and help you understand the next steps.
Wise

reviews.title: Everything was great.
reviews.author: G. B.
reviews.replyText: Hi Gerald, That’s wonderful to hear! We love knowing everything went smoothly for you. Thank you for taking the time to leave such kind feedback, and we look forward to supporting your next transfer! Wise

Hey Kim, Thanks so much for your review! We're really glad you found Wise easy, informative and quick to use — that's exactly what we're aiming for. Here's to many more smooth transfers for you 💚
Wise.
